_doc: Combat stats of weapons, keyed by component id (read by scripts/combat/weapons.gd; the arena also fires the test_* ids without a placed component). kind: laser (hitscan), bolt (projectile), flak (several spread projectiles), missile (slow, homing, splash, passes shields) or beam (a hitscan line held for duration; damage is per second). damage_type: kinetic, energy, explosive or ion. cooldown and duration in seconds, range in pixels, arc in degrees (360 is a turret; the arc is centred on the direction from the ship's centre through the weapon), speed in px/s, turn in rad/s, spread in degrees, splash in cells. pierce: how many more solid cells leftover damage may punch through. fire_chance: chance per shot to start a fire at the first cell hit. Kinds have defaults for the keys left out (see weapons.gd).
